findings.text: Item 2: F2 and F3 ADDRESSED (both repros pass; mutations fail). New regression in an in-memory ui-t18-catchup test: load message 1/cursor 1, reconnect with server messages 1..2, hold the after=1 response, deliver message_updated(2, 'edited live'), then release it. Output: beforeRelease='edited live', afterRelease='m2'; base preserves 'edited live'. Catch-up overwrites newer SSE state. Make REST merges preserve newer live revisions and add this delayed-response regression.
